notes: A scalar subquery that matches no row evaluates to NULL, so `note` is nullable however NOT NULL its source column might be -- and here the source is nullable too. EXISTS is the opposite: it is a total predicate, true or false, never NULL. Seeded with an m that has no n, so the correlated subquery really does come back empty.
